# 💳 Admin Reports (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Admin SDK reference for the gws CLI: query activities (Admin console, Drive), manage push-notification channels, and pull customer, entity and user usage reports, with a discover-first workflow (`gws admin-reports --help`, `gws schema admin-reports.<resource>.<method>`) to build correct --params and --json flags. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: you need Google Workspace admin privileges for these APIs — a regular user account gets permission errors; the skill assumes the gws-shared skill has been read first for auth and global flags (run `gws generate-skills` if it's missing), and usage-report data can lag by up to 48 hours behind real time. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
